homeDescription: Small Family Hobby Farm raising Registered Nigerian Dwarfs, La Manchas, and Poultry.
kiddingScheduleDescription:
2025-2026 Breeding/Kidding Schedule
There is no cost for a reservation on a kid. The cost of a doeling starts out at $350. Doelings can go on the bottle or wait until weaning. Wethers will be sold at 5 to 7 days old for $75, after the first week, the cost will go up $5 each week they are still here. Maximum price for wether will be $150. No registered bucks will be sold this year. Any wether taken as a bottle baby can be brought back to me at the appropriate age for castration using burdizzo. All kids will be disbudded. CD&T vaccine will be given at 6 weeks and boosted at 10 weeks of age.
Discount of $25 for 4H or youth registered with ADGA
We reserve the right to retain any kid for any reason. 
No single goats will be sold unless the buyer already has goats.
